title: Ostomy Supply Program: Balances Still Expected to Change and the Amount a Payment Plan Finances
content:
**Revenue cycle note - Ostomy Supply Program.** Postings whose amount is still expected to change are left out of the amount a payment plan finances: they are taken off the balance due before the amount is financed.

## The rule

Where the program's most recent corrected claim has been transmitted and no remittance has posted on it yet, the patient responsibility posted on the remittance of that shipment's original claim is left out; where no corrected claim awaits a remittance but the program's most recent first-level appeal has been filed and no decision has posted on it - neither an upheld decision (a new denial posted against the appeal filing) nor an overturning one (a second remittance posted on the appealed claim), the patient responsibility posted on the remittance of the appealed claim is left out; otherwise nothing is left out.

## Input - judgement - output

| Program's billing records | What is left out of the amount financed |
|---|---|
| The most recent corrected claim is transmitted and no remittance has posted on it | The patient responsibility on the remittance of that shipment's original claim |
| No corrected claim awaits a remittance; the most recent first-level appeal is filed with no decision posted on it (no new denial against the filing and no second remittance on the appealed claim) | The patient responsibility on the remittance of the claim that appeal concerns |
| Both a corrected claim awaiting remittance and an undecided first-level appeal | Only the corrected claim's original remittance responsibility (the corrected claim is looked at first) |
| Neither | Nothing; the whole balance due is financed |

**Terms.** An upheld decision on a first-level appeal is a new denial posted against the appeal filing; an overturning decision is a second remittance posted on the appealed claim. The remittance of a claim is the claim adjudication posted against it, and its patient responsibility is the amount that adjudication added to the customer's balance.

*Hypothetical illustration:* balance due USD 300.00, of which USD 80.00 is patient responsibility on the original claim of a shipment whose corrected claim awaits its remittance. The amount financed is USD 220.00.
